question: What level of secrecy is attributed to the teaching concerning Dakṣiṇā Kālikā?
premises: The listener is asked to hear attentively.
It is described as a great and well-concealed secret.
inference: The teaching of Dakṣiṇā Kālikā is presented as a supremely guarded secret.
plain_english: Listen, O beloved: this is a great secret of Dakṣiṇā, well concealed.
